text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
T-That was an insane race...! I didn't 
know much about Inari One, but the sheer 
power in her running is mind-blowing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, didn't she come from the local 
circuit just like Oguri? Man, we've got an 
absolute monster on our hands...!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent start, Inari One……! Keep 
this momentum going and stir things up 
even more……! I know you can do it—

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
“Look at how splendid you are, 
Inari-chan...! Yeah! That's our boss!”

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
It's truly... amazing...! And to think she 
used to be so tiny...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: So cool...! Big sis, you're dazzling...!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like the drinks are gonna taste 
damn good tonight.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right! I felt that one...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—I mean, Inari One can run like this, so 
why was she so low-profile last year?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I looked into it and apparently she was 
aiming for Ohi's GⅠs. Uh... like the 
"Tokyo Daishoten." Seems she won there.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! I had no idea... Did she 
figure it's easier to win in the local 
circuits, so she'd build up her reputation 
there first...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(――With today's run, I've barely managed 
to let the firework that is me catch a 
corner of everyone's eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(That's nowhere near enough...! To declare 
that regional races are in no way inferior 
to the Central ones, I still――)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...It's too early to celebrate like 
crazy. The road toward Horse Girl of the 
Year—toward the top—has only just begun!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone's watching me, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went out to greet Inari One after her 
splendid performance, but a sharp tension 
still lingered in her expression—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Boss. Where's the next stage I oughta 
step onto?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sis. Where's the next stage I should step 
up to?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering today's result, our next 
challenge was naturally decided. That 
grand finale of the first half of the 
year—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So next time, I'm rampaging at medium 
distance, huh? Bring it on! I'll make sure 
the Takarazuka Kinen is just like today—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No, that's wrong. I'm gonna put up results 
that surpass today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this, I felt confident we could 
achieve great results in the upcoming 
Takarazuka Kinen as well, feeling 
reassured on one hand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Part of me felt that something was amiss.
